rationale: The stock gapped up ~12% on mixed earnings (revenue beat but significant EPS miss, no revenue growth), and is now trading at 81.9% of its intraday range with momentum appearing to stall near the high — last five candles show a push toward $18.07 but on rapidly declining volume (52K → 5.5K), suggesting buying exhaustion rather than a clean continuation. The negative earnings context (EPS miss of -18.37%, flat revenue) creates overhead resistance and fade risk, but the strong relative volume (4.39x) and price holding above VWAP/9-EMA makes a clean short setup equally uncertain; with 116 minutes to close and no clear directional edge, the risk/reward does not justify a new position.
